empty_phases.definition: a closed phase whose every ledger tool call (if any) was get_status or end_phase: the agent read nothing beyond the status and made no move

container.egress: public internet only: private, loopback, link-local and host-gateway addresses rejected, except DNS to the container's resolvers and the driver's port on the host gateway; no IPv6 beyond loopback

prompt_check.method: one-word prompt; the context Cursor recorded
